disk_edge.note: The main result uses the centre of each disc. These two cases move the clearance margin by the disc's angular radius to bracket that assumption: upper limb counts a target as visible when any part of its disc clears the skyline, whole disc only when all of it does. Nominal radii: Sun 0.27 deg, Earth 0.95 deg (Earth's varies from about 0.90 to 1.03 deg over the lunar orbit; not modelled).
